name: UE Furniture Co., Ltd.
summary: UE Furniture Co., Ltd., an enterprise headquartered in Huzhou, China, since its establishment in 2001, specializes in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of a varied selection of furniture. Its product offerings include office seating, therapeutic massage chairs, sofas, and specialized chair fittings. The company serves customers across both domestic Chinese markets and international territories, with its merchandise also available for purchase through online retail channels.
